annotations: Every road re-rated on 2026-11-13 with one lean rater brief: one rater for every road, a second for the doubtful ones, a third where those two disagreed. A row for every way the re-rate rated, whether or not its level changed, so no way is left to an agency level or a later formula change; each retires the row in force on that way, the owner's own earlier rating rows among them (the owner, 2026-11-13: "Ignore my own calls", "The goal here is no specific overrides"). Baltimore streets whose bike facility the city records and the map lacks were rated with that record as a fact. Ways an agency rates that had no row of ours were rated the same way (an agency rating alone is not a rating: the owner, 2026-11-13). Closed roads and access rows are left as they are. Method and results: reports/rerate-2026-11-13/REPORT.md.
